label: Tier Matrix DUs
description: Demand units included in the scenario tier matrix for M&I statistics

label: North of Delta
description: Demand units located north of the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta

label: South of Delta
description: Demand units located south of the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta

label: SWP Served
description: Demand units that receive State Water Project water

label: CVP Served
description: Demand units that receive Central Valley Project water

label: SWP Delivery Points
description: CalSim3 SWP delivery nodes (ESB* CSB* SBA*)

label: WBA Delivery Units
description: Demand units using WBA-style DL_* total delivery variables. These have pre-calculated total delivery in CalSim output.

label: Groundwater Only Units
description: Demand units with no surface water delivery. Only have GP_* groundwater pumping and GW_SHORT_* restriction shortage variables.

label: SWP Contractor Units
description: Demand units receiving water via SWP contractor delivery arcs (D_*_PMI). Shortage tracked via SHORT_D_*_PMI.

label: Named Locality Units
description: Named localities with specific delivery arcs (D_*). Some require summing multiple arcs. Includes water treatment plant deliveries.

label: Missing Variable Units
description: Demand units in the canonical tier matrix but with no corresponding CalSim output variables found.
